payload.focus: Tanya's sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock, sprint delivery and team performance
payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches three overlapping regions: (1) the Zephyr integration and velocity claims, which directly extend Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven from the prior Sprint 4 retro; (2) the anti-Slack positioning narrative and its foundational problem narrative (Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate, Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus) that the shipped widget is meant to validate; and (3) the next-sprint context-preservation position (Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint) that this retro's velocity and shipping results feed into. I expanded the webhook architecture and pricing-tier positions because they are co-located in the same Sprint 4 source and the document's Zephyr mention could bear on both. I deliberately did not expand Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams or Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform — the retro does not reference ICP or category definition, so those would be reaching.
